about_short_description.short_description: Abyan Capital is a financial service company that provides an automated solution and portfolio management for long-term investments.

product.name: Abyan Financial App
product.description: A digital investment platform for opening an account, selecting portfolios, making investments, scheduling contributions, and monitoring portfolio performance.

product.name: Abyan Diversified Investment Portfolio
product.description: A professionally managed portfolio that invests across diversified Saudi and international assets, including equities and funds, for long-term capital growth.

product.name: Abyan Savings Portfolio
product.description: A savings-oriented portfolio that invests in money market funds to provide liquidity and help preserve the value of idle cash.

product.name: Abyan Saudi Market Portfolio
product.description: A managed portfolio focused on Saudi-market investments and designed for investors seeking higher exposure to domestic equities and capital growth.

product.name: Investment Planning and Scheduled Contributions
product.description: Digital tools and services for setting financial goals, estimating potential investment outcomes, and automating recurring monthly contributions.

identifier.value: Investment Dealing, Management, and Custody Services

product.name: Investment Dealing, Management, and Custody Services
product.description: Regulated financial services covering investment dealing, discretionary portfolio management, and custody of client investments.
